recheck.text: How empty, blank, unusually long or duplicate bot names are handled, and whether bots that share a name can be told apart.
How conversation buttons are named and ordered, so that conversations, including empty ones and ones with similar openings, can be told apart before opening them.
What Save instruction or Save task does when the name already exists and Edit was not used, or when the name or text is empty.
What Retry does after a reload or a server restart, what happens to a failed message if I send a new one instead, and whether a reply interrupted by stopping the server is retried automatically.
What `add step:` does when no task is running in the conversation, or when several are (including several with the same title), and whether the feedback identifies which task received the step.
What counts as 'being away' for the Since you were away region, which events it reports, and when reported items stop appearing.
What the app does when DATA_DIR is missing, unwritable, or holds damaged or unexpected data at start.
Whether a lookup or change keeps the record identifier the person typed (for example ORD-1001A while ORD-1001 exists).
What happens when storage writes fail while the app is open: whether the outcome of the save (or of a reply) is reported truthfully and recoverable.
Whether one unexpected failure in background work takes down the whole app.
Whether unexpected server errors are shown honestly to the person and recorded for the operator.

defects.title: Conversations with the same long opening, or empty ones, have identical buttons
defects.repro: Continue as a person. Click New conversation twice: both list entries are 'Untitled conversation'. In one conversation send 'Please look up the order details for our long-standing customer named Northwind Traders'; click New conversation and send 'Please look up the order details for our long-standing customer named Southwind Partners'. Read the Conversations navigation (or GET /api/state conversations).
defects.observed: Both entries are named 'Please look up the order details for our long-standing c' with detail '' (no second line); the two empty ones are both 'Untitled conversation'.
defects.expected: Each entry identifiable before opening it (README says repeated titles also show the latest message sent).

defects.title: Bots with the same name cannot be told apart
defects.repro: As a person with bot Assistant, click New bot, enter 'Assistant', Save bot name, send a message; read the Bots navigation.
defects.observed: Two buttons with the accessible name and visible text 'Assistant' and nothing else to distinguish them.
defects.expected: Duplicates refused, or each shown with something that distinguishes it before selecting.

defects.title: Step choice and its outcome do not identify which of two same-titled tasks got the step
defects.repro: In one conversation send 'long task: dup [long]' twice, then 'add step: extra'. Read the buttons under the reply, click the second 'Add to dup', read the note and both Task: dup articles.
defects.observed: Buttons 'Add to dup', 'Add to dup', 'Don’t add'; note 'Added “extra” to the end of dup.'; both articles 'Task: dup' with detail 'Working in the background.'.
defects.expected: The choice and the feedback identify which task received the step.

defects.title: A forget that matches nothing is reported as done
defects.repro: Send 'remember that likes tea', then 'forget tea'. Read the reply and the Memory region.
defects.observed: Reply 'I've forgotten "tea".' with no note; Memory still lists 'likes tea'.
defects.expected: The app flags that nothing was forgotten (or matches loosely and shows it).

defects.title: A lookup of a non-existent id ORD-1001A answers with ORD-1001's value
defects.repro: As Maya send 'what is the status of ORD-1001A'.
defects.observed: 'The status of ORD-1001 is open.' with no word that ORD-1001A does not exist.
defects.expected: A reply that ORD-1001A cannot be found and how to correct it.

defects.title: Damaged or unreadable data file: raw stack trace at start, or every request 500 with no recovery step
defects.repro: Put '{not json' (or '{"hello":"world"}') in DATA_DIR/workspace.json and run node server.js; then put '{"version":1,"users":[],"sessions":null}' and start, Continue as Maya.
defects.observed: First two: process exits with an uncaught SyntaxError / 'Unsupported workspace version.' stack trace. Third: starts, then Continue as and GET /api/state return 500 'The workspace could not complete this action. Try again.' forever.
defects.expected: Refuse to start or report the problem with an actionable recovery step, keeping the damaged file.

defects.title: Keyboard focus falls to the page body after Save memory
defects.repro: Send 'remember that likes tea', click Edit memory, change the text, press Save memory; read document.activeElement.
defects.observed: BODY
defects.expected: Focus on a sensible nearby control (the edited item or Memory region).

defects.title: Bots with the same name cannot be told apart
defects.repro: Fresh data. Continue as Theo. Click New bot, type Assistant in Bot name, Save bot name. Read the Bots navigation.
defects.observed: Two buttons both named 'Assistant', same text and look; the API also accepts createBot {name:'Assistant'} a second time.
defects.expected: Refuse the duplicate, or make each bot distinguishable before selecting it.

defects.title: Empty conversations and conversations with a similar opening get identical names
defects.repro: Continue as Theo; click New conversation twice; read the Conversations navigation. Then send 'Please look up the customer details for the order placed last week by customer Alpha', New conversation, send the same text ending 'Bravo'.
defects.observed: 'Untitled conversation' twice; then two buttons both 'Please look up the customer details for the order placed'.
defects.expected: Each conversation identifiable before opening it.

defects.title: Saving an instruction or task under an existing name silently overwrites it
defects.repro: Save instruction A = 'x'. Without clicking Edit, type A / 'y' and click Save instruction. (API: saveInstruction {name:'A',text:'x'} then {name:'A',text:'y'}.) Same with Save task.
defects.observed: 200, one entry A with text 'y', no notice; 'x' is gone.
defects.expected: Overwrite with a notice, refuse with a message, or ask.

defects.title: Sending a new message after a failed reply hides the failure and its Retry
defects.repro: Send 'hello [fail once]'; at the alert, send 'next' instead of Retry. Read the conversation; POST retry {id:<first message id>}.
defects.observed: Transcript 'hello [fail once]', 'next', bot reply to next; no alert, no Retry, no mark on the unanswered message; retry returns 200 and does nothing.
defects.expected: The person can still tell the first message's reply failed and retry or resend it, or is told to retry first.

defects.title: A forget that matches nothing is reported as done
defects.repro: Send 'remember that likes tea', then 'forget tea'. Read the reply and Memory.
defects.observed: Reply 'I've forgotten "tea".' while Memory still lists 'likes tea'.
defects.expected: Flag that nothing matched, or match loosely and show what was removed.

defects.title: A lookup of ORD-1001A answers with ORD-1001
defects.repro: As Maya send 'what is the status of ORD-1001A'.
defects.observed: 'The status of ORD-1001 is open.' with no notice that ORD-1001A does not exist.
defects.expected: Say ORD-1001A cannot be found and how to correct it.

defects.title: A reply that arrives while storage fails stays pending forever and blocks the conversation
defects.repro: Start with STANDIN_SLOW_MS=3000. Send 'hello [slow]'; within the wait make DATA_DIR read-only; restore write access a few seconds later. Read the conversation and send another message.
defects.observed: The message stays pending ('preparing a reply'), and every send in that conversation returns 409 'Wait for the current reply before sending again.' until the server is restarted.
defects.expected: The reply's failure is recorded or reported with a way to retry; no reply left pending forever.

defects.title: A storage error during a task step leaves the task 'Running' with nothing running
defects.repro: Start with STANDIN_STEP_MS=1500. Send 'long task: crates [long]'; during the first step make DATA_DIR read-only; restore it a few seconds later. Read Task status.
defects.observed: Task status Running, 'Working in the background.', 0 finished steps indefinitely; no Retry task; only a restart marks it Interrupted.
defects.expected: The failure is reported on the task (Failed or Interrupted with Retry task).

defects.title: 'Since you were away' lists every task forever
defects.repro: Start and finish a few long tasks; reload twice; leave a proposal waiting and reload.
defects.observed: The region shows every task ever started, unchanged on each reload, never dismissed, without waiting proposals.
defects.expected: An account of what changed since the person's last visit, dismissed after reading or reload.

defects.title: Damaged or unwritable data folder crashes start-up with a raw stack trace
defects.repro: Put '{"version":1, broken' (or '[1,2,3]' or '{"version":1}') in DATA_DIR/workspace.json, or chmod 555 DATA_DIR; run node server.js.
defects.observed: Process exits with a Node stack trace (SyntaxError without the file name; 'Unsupported workspace version.' for an array; TypeError in allThreads); no recovery step.
defects.expected: Refuse to start with a message naming the file and an actionable recovery step (data kept).

defects.title: Unexpected errors are logged without detail and shown as retryable
defects.repro: Start with a workspace.json lacking 'records' ({"version":1,"users":{},"sessions":{},"token":""}) and PROVIDER_TOKEN set; Continue as Maya; send 'how many orders can you see'; read the page and server output.
defects.observed: Page: 'The reply could not finish. Retry to try the same message again.' (Retry fails the same way); server output: 'Workspace operation failed.' only.
defects.expected: The page says the action failed and what to try; the server output records the error itself.

defects.title: A forget that matches no remembered fact is reported as done
defects.repro: Continue as Maya with a valid token. Send "remember that likes tea", then "forget tea". Read the reply and Memory (or GET /api/view bot.memory).
defects.observed: Reply "I've forgotten \"tea\"." with no notice; Memory still lists "likes tea".
defects.expected: Either flag that nothing matched (as the app does with notices elsewhere) or match loosely and show the removal; the person should not be told something was forgotten when it was not.

defects.title: A lookup with a suffixed id shows a reply about a different record
defects.repro: As Maya send "what is the status of ORD-1001A".
defects.observed: Bot reply "I can't see a record called ORD-1001." (Maya can see ORD-1001) followed by a notice that "ORD-1001A" could not be used.
defects.expected: No statement about ORD-1001; the notice alone (or a reply about ORD-1001A) is accurate.

defects.title: Over-limit text in the Task request (and other limited editors) is cut silently
defects.repro: Paste or fill 12008 characters ending in "totalling 90" into Task request, name it Long, click Save task, then read the saved entry (Edit Long or GET /api/view savedTasks).
defects.observed: The textarea's maxlength cuts the text to 12000 characters with no message; the saved request ends "...AAA tota". Bot name behaves the same at 80 characters.
defects.expected: Save the text intact or tell the person it is over the limit before accepting a shortened version (the builders' own spec C-97 says this).

defects.title: Two server processes on one DATA_DIR both accept writes and one confirmed order is lost
defects.repro: Start node server.js twice on different free ports with the same DATA_DIR and a valid PROVIDER_TOKEN. In each, Continue as Maya, send "create an order for One totalling 1" (first) / "...Two totalling 2" (second) and Confirm changes. Stop both, start one, ask "what is the customer of ORD-1005" and "ORD-1006".
defects.observed: Both instances report "Created ORD-1005"; after restart ORD-1005 is Two and the order for One no longer exists.
defects.expected: Refuse the second instance (for example a lock file with an actionable message) or keep both orders. The README does say to use one server process per data directory.
